item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
First release

  • One number for every platform — Stripe, RevenueCat, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo Payments, Gumroad and any custom HTTPS endpoint, added up in your currency.
  • MRR computed properly — yearly plans divided by twelve, seats and quantities counted, percentage coupons applied, trials counted but priced at zero, usage-based plans flagged instead of guessed.
  • Menu bar modes — MRR, MRR + 30-day change, ARR, 28-day revenue, active subscriptions, one source at a time, or icon only.
  • Trend — a daily local snapshot builds a 90-day sparkline and the "vs 30 days ago" delta.
  • Privacy mode, light/dark appearance, and Discord/Slack notifications for MRR milestones and a daily summary.
  • Private by design — API keys live in the macOS Keychain, no account, no server, no telemetry.
